upcoming.title: Doumar’s Cruise In | Nov. 4th
upcoming.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, November 4th | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

Hope to see you there!

upcoming.title: Flashback 1st Fridays | November 6th
upcoming.body: Our events will be every 1st Friday of the month starting with September 4th as our kickoff! Each 1st Friday, Westside Burgers will turn back the clock to provide a vintage diner experience for our guests! The Westside dining room will be themed into a classic 1950's diner, with food and drink deals from 5pm-close, as well as special decor and activities. We will also hold a limbo competition with $25 gift card for the winner. The first 25 guests will receive a coupon to use that evening for a $1.95 plain hamburger. Deals will be held from 5pm until close or while supplies last. To promote our theme, we are asking the community to show off their vintage cars in the Westside lot! As well as securing a spot to our fun 50's flashback, drivers who bring their classic cars/hotrods will be guaranteed a single $1.95 burger coupon for that evening. Of course, there is always the added bonus of bragging rights and chance to show off your ride!

upcoming.title: Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Official Toy Collection Day and MCT All Makes and Models Car Show | Nov. 14th
upcoming.body:
The Mustang Club of Tidewater, in conjunction with the US Marine Corps Reserve, is proud to announce we will be holding our Third Annual Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Official Toy Collection Day and Mustang Club of Tidewater All Makes and Models Car Show!! This show is to support the Toys for Tots Hampton Roads program as they ramp up for Christmas, 2026. The car show is open to the public, so bring your favorite car, truck, or bike/trike and help support your community!! We ask that you be generous in your donations of new, unwrapped toys for boys and girls in the Hampton Roads area. Click the header event image to see the show flyer!

Location: Landstown Commons Shopping Center, 3312 Princess Anne Road, Virginia Beach, VA, 23456, in the southwest parking lot adjacent to Princess Anne Road. Enter to the left of and behind Dollar Tree. Directional signs will be posted.

Date/Times: November 14th, 2026. - Toys for Tots Toy Collection by the USMC is from 9:00am until 2:30 pm, when the awards presentation begins. - Car Show from 10:00a.m until 3:00p.m. - Registration for the Car Show and the Drive Through Toy Drop-Off Lane will both open at 9:00 a.m. Registration for the Car Show closes at 1:00 PM. Judging will be completed by 1:30 PM. We invite you to participate as an entrant or spectator, but if you cannot, there will be a Drive-Through Drop Off Lane for the community to make in person donations at the Toy Collection Event site!! To that end, please pass the word to family, friends, and coworkers to help us collect as many toys as possible and other donations that we can, in order to support the kids in Hampton Roads this holiday season!!! Please keep in mind that all donations are kept and disbursed here in the Hampton Roads area, so we’re supporting our own community.

Admission: The registration fee for vehicles entering the car show is $20, plus at least 1 new, unwrapped toy, for donation to the Toys for Tots Hampton Roads program. The first 100 registered vehicles will receive a Dash Plaque for the show. We will be keeping tally of the number of toys donated by each registrant and club/group. There is NO Pre-Registration for this show. All registration payments and toy collections will happen at the show site. There is no charge for spectators to visit the show area, but we do ask that you make a toy or monetary donation to Toys for Tots while visiting. Again, please ignore any messages you may see asking you to pre-register, as the MCT does not do pre-registration.

Toy/Monetary Donations: There will be a designated drive through drop-off lane for community members to donate toys at the show location. If you can't make it to the event, you can make a monetary donation directly to TFT by scanning the QR Code on the event flyer. All donations will directly support operations in the Hampton Roads area. Music and Announcements: Will be provided by DJ Vinlo! The US National Anthem will be played at Noon as we show respect to the Flag of our Nation and thank the attending Marines and other military members and veterans for their service!

Show Details: This is a Participant's Choice show. All registered entrants will be provided with voting slips to record their top 25 vehicle choices. Only one vote per vehicle on your voting sheet. Please be fair in your selections! Spectators will receive a judging slip to pick their favorite vehicle.

Awards will be made as follows: - Best in Show - Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Hampton Roads Choice - Most Toys Donated by Group/Club participating in the Car Show - Most Toys Donated by an Individual participating in the Car Show - Top 25 Participant Choices based on Participant voting - Top Spectator Choice based on Spectator voting Schedule for November 14th: - 0800: Set up show lot, toy donation collection points, and vendor displays. No show vehicles will be admitted prior to 0830 (except for MCT and TFT members working the show). - 0900: Registration desk opens for the show. Toy collection begins for car show participants, show spectators, and the public wishing to make toy donations. - 1000: Car show officially starts. Participant and Spectator Judging begins. - 1030: Driver meeting with info on show, vendors and other pertinent information. - 1200: National Anthem is played. All military vets and members recognized. - 1300: Car Show Registration Ends. Toy collection continues until 1430. - 1330: Car Show Judging Ends. Please have your judging slips turned in by this time. - 1430: Toys for Tots Toy Collection Ends. Award Presentations Begin, 50/50 Drawing Held. - 1500: Car Show Ends.

Please depart in a safe and orderly manner. No Loud music, Burnouts, or Exhibitions of Speed. This is a very busy shopping center that grants us permission to use their parking area for shows. We don't want to risk losing this site.

If you or your organization wish to be a Named Sponsor for this show, or you wish to set up as a vendor, please send a request to "mustangcluboftidewater67@yahoo.com" with your name, organization, and contact information. Due to a non-compete clause with Landstown Commons businesses, we cannot allow certain food/drink vendors to participate at this show. Our thanks to Arcadia Property Management the Car Club Council of Hampton Roads for arranging our use of the show site. The USMC Reserve Toys for Tots Staff and the members of the Mustang Club of Tidewater thank everyone that will be attending and/or supporting this event. We hope for a great turnout from our community! Thank you for participating! You can see the event on our website calendar at https://www.mustangcluboftidewater.org/ or on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61571330402613

past.title: Air & Auto Classic 14 | Oct 10th
past.body:
Air & Auto Classic 14

Hosted by First Settlers Region Porsche Club of America

Saturday, October 10th | 10a-4p

Located Military Aviation Museum, 1341 Princess Anne Rd, Virginia Beach, VA 23457

Please join us for our annual Air & Auto Classic charity car show, on October 10th at the Military Aviation Museum in Virginia Beach. It's a great opportunity to show off your pride and joy, check out the fabulous aviation museum and its collection of vintage aircraft, and contribute to some great charitable organizations through your participation. The show is open to all years of Foreign and Domestic cars, Vintage, Street Rods, Rat Rods, Muscle Cars, Race Cars, Sports Cars, and Special Builds.  "If you're proud of it, bring it!" 

Come out and enjoy the music, vintage aircraft, camaraderie and some friendly competition. Registration for show participants (pre-registration not required for Regular or Corral parking): If you want your car or motorcycle to be judged, we ask that you arrive between 9 - 11 am. There will be trailer parking available. - Regular Registration:  $30. Includes admission to the entire museum for everyone in your car, along with an Air & Auto Classic dash plaque for the first 100 registrants. Kindly note that the event organizer reserves the right to reclass entries. - Rockstar Parking Registration:  $75.  Includes all of the above, plus a swag bag including an event shirt (total value is over $50), and parking in a special area on the flight line.  You'll also be making a larger donation to charity!  Rockstar registration is extremely limited (only 40 spots) and can only be done online via this website. - Non-Judged Corral Parking: $20.  Non-judged parking adjacent to the flight line. 

There is no pre-registration for this option, just show up and pay when you arrive.  This option includes a dash plaque (while supplies last) and admission to the museum. - Spectator attendance is $20 per person - Includes Museum entry.
